notes.title: A Heartfelt Thank You!
notes.content:
A heartfelt thank you to all of you!

We are very grateful for the response to the release of Flora Domina. When we asked for your reviews, we were hoping to receive 10, but we were pleasantly surprised to receive nearly double that amount.

Your honest and sometimes confronting feedback has been invaluable in guiding us towards the right direction for future updates. During the short development period, we faced various design, technical, and time limitations. While most of our team members have embarked on new journeys, I will continue to work on the game, occasionally joined by our sound designer.

In the upcoming update, my primary focus will be on balancing and enhancing the gameplay experience. As I'll be working on this during my spare time, I expect its completion within approximately a month.

Any feedback meanwhile can be posted in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2285500/discussions/]Discussions section[/url].
Your support and enthusiasm have been instrumental in shaping the future of Flora Domina, and we are excited to deliver an improved version that meets your expectations.

Once again, thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Dave

notes.title: Flora Domina is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Nature Guardians!

We're thrilled to announce that Flora Domina is [b]now available on Steam![/b]

Flora Domina was developed by a team of talented students from Digital Arts and Entertainment, along with a brilliant student composer from The School of Arts Gent, over a period of 11 weeks. We are proud to present this charming game to all of you and we hope that it brings you plenty of joy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43945370/14cb34736bc3cca184fc2898fc0a8f969db6589b.png[/img]

[b]We would love to hear your feedback! Please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285500/Flora_Domina/#app_reviews_hash]leaving a review[/url] to let us know what you think. [/b]If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to post them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2285500/discussions/]Discussions section[/url], and we will do our best to implement them.

Although most of us are moving on to new ventures or jobs, we will continue to provide updates to improve the game whenever possible. So, don't forget to try out the game, keep an eye on this page, and most importantly, have fun!

Thank you for your support!

Dave and the Flora Domina team.
